name: The Choking
description: A hollow with no through draught. The air is thick and warm and tastes of dust and iron, and a candle here would stand straight up. Sound arrives flat and stops close. Everything is arranged for people who could not breathe easily.

pois.label: Dead air
pois.text: Step in and the pressure changes in your ears. The dust does not settle out of it; it hangs, and turning your head moves it and nothing else.

pois.label: Low stools
pois.text: Set in a ring, all of them low enough that sitting puts your chin near your knees. The seats are polished in a way that says long sitting, not use.

pois.label: Bowl of iron dust
pois.text: A shallow bowl of rust-red powder set on a flat stone. A finger has been drawn through it in a line that stops halfway, as if the hand tired.
